//! A stable, usable-outside-the-compiler wrapper around Rust's token stream API.
//!
//! The compiler's `proc_macro` API is only available inside procedural macro
//! crates. This crate builds on `proc-macro2` to provide token-stream helpers
//! that work the same way in `proc-macro` crates, build scripts, tests, and
//! ordinary binaries.

use proc_macro2::{TokenStream, TokenTree};

pub use proc_macro2;

/// Return the number of token trees in `tokens`.
pub fn token_tree_count(tokens: TokenStream) -> usize {
    tokens.into_iter().count()
}

/// Recursively count every token tree, descending into delimited groups.
pub fn token_count(tokens: TokenStream) -> usize {
    tokens
        .into_iter()
        .map(|tt| match tt {
            TokenTree::Group(group) => 1 + token_count(group.stream()),
            _ => 1,
        })
        .sum()
}

/// Flatten `tokens` into a single sequence without delimiters.
pub fn flatten(tokens: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {
    let mut out = TokenStream::new();
    for tt in tokens {
        match tt {
            TokenTree::Group(g) => out.extend(flatten(g.stream())),
            other => out.extend(std::iter::once(other)),
        }
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {

}
